title: Signatory Rights Attestation
description: Attests which natural or legal persons hold full signatory rights to engage a legal person, as registered in a national business register (EWC WP3).

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the Signatory Rights attestation.

legal_person_name.description: Official current legal person name as registered in the business register.

legal_person_id.description: Unique id for organisations in EUID structure.

signatory_rights.description: Information about the persons and their signatory rights over the legal person.

post.description: Role of the signatory as registered.

name.description: Name of the post as registered.

signatory_rights_held_by_person.description: Signatory right held by a natural person.

full_name.description: Full name of the natural person representing the company.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the natural person representing the company.

nationality.description: Nationality of the natural person representing the company.

signatory_rule.description: Information if the signatory can engage the company alone or jointly.

signatory_rights_held_by_legal_person.description: Signatory right held by a legal person.

legal_person_name.description: Official current legal person name of the signatory as registered in the business register.

legal_person_id.description: Unique id of the signatory organisation in EUID structure.

signatory_rule.description: Information if the signatory can engage the company alone or jointly.
